```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
con = dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "me315.sqlite")
```

## 1.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT STATE, MIN(ACRES) AS MENOR_AREA FROM PRESERVE
GROUP BY STATE
```

## 2.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT STATE, MAX(ACRES) AS MAIOR_AREA FROM PRESERVE
WHERE ACRES < 10000
GROUP BY STATE
```

## 3.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT STATE, MAX(ACRES) AS MAIOR_AREA FROM PRESERVE
WHERE ACRES < 10000
GROUP BY STATE
ORDER BY MAIOR_AREA DESC
```

## 4.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT STATE, MAX(ACRES) AS MAIOR_AREA FROM PRESERVE
GROUP BY STATE
HAVING MAIOR_AREA < 25000
```

## 5.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT STATE, MIN(ACRES) AS MENOR_AREA FROM PRESERVE
GROUP BY STATE
HAVING MENOR_AREA < 100
```

## 6.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT STATE, PNAME, MAX(ACRES) AS MAIOR_AREA FROM PRESERVE
WHERE ACRES > 1000
GROUP BY STATE
HAVING MAIOR_AREA < 25000
```

## 7.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT STATE, SUM(ACRES) AS TAMANHO_TOTAL FROM PRESERVE
GROUP BY STATE
HAVING TAMANHO_TOTAL BETWEEN 10000 AND 50000
```

## 8.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT STATE, AVG(ACRES) AS MEDIA_ACRES FROM PRESERVE
GROUP BY STATE
ORDER BY AVG(ACRES) DESC
LIMIT 1
```

## 9.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT DNO, AVG(SALARY) AS SALARIO_MEDIO FROM EMPLOYEE
GROUP BY DNO
```

## 10.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT DNO, SUM(SALARY) AS SOMA_SALARIOS, MAX(SALARY) AS MAIOR_SALARIO, MIN(SALARY) AS MENOR_SALARIO FROM EMPLOYEE
GROUP BY DNO
```

## 11.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT DNO, COUNT(*) AS QTD_FUNCIONARIOS FROM EMPLOYEE
WHERE DNO <> 40
GROUP BY DNO;
```

## 12.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT DNO, COUNT(*) AS QTD_FUNCIONARIOS FROM EMPLOYEE
GROUP BY DNO
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
```

## 13.

```{sql connection=con}
SELECT STATE, SUM(ACRES) FROM PRESERVE
GROUP BY STATE

UNION ALL

SELECT 'Total', SUM(ACRES) FROM PRESERVE
```
